g.text: data/manifest.yaml: 6 SRM policy URLs with type, format (pdf/html), title
• SHA-256 checksum; flag a document that changed since the last fetch
scripts/ingest.py reads each raw file back as bytes + its format
• HTML: BeautifulSoup; remove script/nav/footer, SRM menus and the
• HTML tables: one line per row, naming the table and its columns
• PDF: PyMuPDF page text; drop short lines repeated 3+ times
Clean plain text per document (also saved as .txt)
Text + manifest metadata passed to build_document()
Plain text + university, policy type, title, URL, date
• Lift headings buried mid-line by PDF extraction
• Detect numbered ("7.3 Minimum Attendance"), ALL-CAPS and Roman ("II.
ADMISSION ...") headings; a table row is never a heading
• Text between two headings becomes a Section
Validated Document with Sections (Pydantic): 6 documents, 212 sections
Saved as data/processed/srm/*.json for the index build
• Unique citation ID per section: Document.citations()
• Drop contents-page noise: < 3 real words, or a short title / unfinished
• Split long sections: ≤ 1,800 chars, 150-char overlap, never across sections
List of Chunks handed to VectorStore.build()
• Prefix "university | policy | section path" for search context
• BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5 on CPU, batch 32, normalized vectors
Vectors stored next to the chunk's original text and metadata
Vectors + original chunk text (no prefix) + metadata
• Metadata: citation_id, university, policy_type, section path, URL
• Write index_manifest.json: model name, dimension, counts
Searched at question time; a BM25 keyword index is built from the same
retrieve.py · retrieve() → store.search() + bm25_index().search() → reciprocal_rank_fusion() → diversify()
• check_ready(): stop if the index was built with a different embedding model
• Hybrid search: embedding search (bge query prefix, cosine) + BM25 keyword search, up to 50 candidates each, same filters
• Merge the two rankings by Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k = 60); score shown = cosine similarity
• diversify(): at most 2 chunks per section, keep top 6
6 RetrievedChunk objects: chunk text, citation_id, score, rank
Question + 6 passages go to claim generation (next diagram)
